description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It is thrown when a pipeline function is unknown, providing methods for building, serializing, and deserializing the exception, and contains metadata such as error code and message templates.

classes.name: PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException
classes.description: Custom immutable exception class thrown when an unknown pipeline function is encountered in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for this exception with a default message based on the function expression.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON object into a PlaceholderFunctionUnknownException instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a mutable builder pre-populated with the current exception's data.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers, conforming to a mutable interface.
